messages.author: 279972f7f3bce770
messages.subject: Error stage 1. "Object 'deci' not found"
parts:
Hello! 

I'm getting an error while running stage 1 (which also terminates the subsequent stages). 

The error is for all 100 bin files from GENEactiv.

"""
$call
g.dotorcomma(datafile, dformat, mon, desiredtz = desiredtz, rmc.dec = rmc.dec)

Errors and warnings for FILENAME pre.bin$message
[1] "object 'deci' not found" 
"""

So i tested the function deciding 'deci' and when i ran that on the bin file seperately i got the following: 
"""
out <- g.dotorcomma(inputfile = FILENAME ,dformat=1,mon=2)
Error in g.dotorcomma(inputfile = FILENAME,  : 
  object 'deci' not found
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 26 appears to contain an embedded nul
2: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 27 appears to contain an embedded nul
3: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 28 appears to contain an embedded nul
4: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 29 appears to contain an embedded nul
5: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 30 appears to contain an embedded nul
6: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 45 appears to contain an embedded nul
7: In scan(fc, skip = sk, what = "", n = 2, sep = ":", quiet = TRUE) :
  embedded nul(s) found in input
"""

So i tried running g.dotorcomma with mon = c(1,3,4), just to test - and sure enough no error. 

Anyone got an idea what might be causing this ? 

I got the latest github release.
